fusions.name: Rising Atoll
fusions.desc: Raises a jagged reef 6 tiles long for 8 seconds. It deals 26 damage that ignores armour to each enemy that crosses it, and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Seeding Cut
fusions.desc: A cut that deals 12 damage and seeds the wound with polyps, [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Lodger in the Reef
fusions.desc: Calls a moray out of the reef for 20 seconds. Every 1.5 seconds it strikes an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage.

fusions.name: Ever-Growing

riders.text: what breaks off you grows back
and the growth never stops to rest
and every layer comes back sooner

fusions.desc: Raises your Recovery by 1, and your Recovery ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your health recovers 12% faster, from silver your stamina recovers 12% faster, and from gold your abilities come round 6% sooner.
